description: This file defines the MessageService class, which provides asynchronous methods to handle message lifecycle operations such as creation, processing, linking to JIRA issues, and auditing. It interacts with database models (Message, AuditLog, JiraSync) and a rule engine to process messages.

classes.name: MessageService
classes.description: Service class for managing message lifecycle activities including creation, processing, linking to JIRA, and auditing.

methods.name: Message create_message(self, content: str)
methods.description: Creates a new message with status 'pending', adds it to the database, and logs the creation.

methods.name: Message process_message(self, message_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Processes a message by ID, applies rules, updates status, and logs success or failure.

methods.name: JiraSync link_jira(self, message_id: uuid.UUID, jira_issue_id: str)
methods.description: Links a message to a JIRA issue and creates a JiraSync record, then logs the linking action.

methods.name: None _audit(self, action: str, details: Optional[str] = None, performed_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None)
methods.description: Internal method to record audit logs with specified actions and details.
